title: cypripedium flavum
intro: Cypripedium flavum, commonly known as the yellow lady's slipper orchid, is a type of terrestrial orchid. This plant is known for its unique, slipper-shaped flowers and is native to the mountainous regions of North America. The health benefits of Cypripedium flavum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety.
